dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Hello, SereMate. Wake up. Could you go and remind Mrs. Schmidt that today she has an appointment with a doctor?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Can you provide details about where Mrs. Schmidt is?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: She's in the right room.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you know her room number?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: No, I don't. Yes, 2001.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello, Mrs. Schmidt. SereMate is here to help. You have an appointment starting in one hour, so we need to get you ready for the appointment.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay. But first, I have to put my shoes on. Could you please bring me my shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you have a specific recommendation?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, the grey-thick boots.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Because the weather today is very cold and it's snowy, so we can choose something that fits the weather.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay, yes, the grey-thick boots. Thank you, SereMate

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Now I'm ready to go. Oh, I feel a bit dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: ehh Do you need any help from my side?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, could you bring me my stick?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I know that you love walking. Would you mind if I help you get to the doctor's appointment myself?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes, but I'd like my stick for support.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello, Mrs. Schmidt. How did your doctor's appointment go?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It went well. The doctor gave me some exercises to do for my hand recovery.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: So, first of all, you need to start with your arm exercises. You can do the elbow flexion first 10 times.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I'll give you the dumbbell that you use, and you can stand up.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: you can do 10 times.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: One. Two. I think maybe you can do it better with a lighter one.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Yes, yes, please. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: We can continue. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Thank you, SereMate.
